_comment: Generated for Pterodactyl Panel. The installer downloads the latest standalone release asset.
name: EaglerXServer Standalone
author: EaglerXServer contributors
description: Standalone Eaglercraft WebSocket proxy with a configurable Minecraft backend.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
apk add --no-cache curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
release_json=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/Cleint123/eaglersetup/releases/latest)
asset_url=$(printf '%s' "$release_json" | jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name | test("^EaglerXServer-Standalone.*\\.jar$")) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$asset_url" ] || [ "$asset_url" = null ]; then
  echo 'No standalone JAR asset was found in the latest GitHub release.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
curl -fL --retry 3 "$asset_url" -o /mnt/server/EaglerXServer-Standalone.jar
cat > /mnt/server/velocity.toml <<EOF
bind = "0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT}"
try = ["${BACKEND_NAME}"]

[servers]
${BACKEND_NAME} = "${BACKEND_ADDRESS}"
EOF

variables.name: Backend Name
variables.description: Name used for the default backend in velocity.toml.

variables.name: Backend Address
variables.description: Backend host and port, for example 192.168.1.10:25565.
